profile.name: Sujit Pranav Reddy
profile.title: Engineering Head
profile.summary: Engineering leader with 12+ years building and modernizing production SaaS platforms in Ruby on Rails and Python (Django, FastAPI), including 6+ years leading engineering teams. Specializes in making legacy systems easier to change and run: consolidated multiple codebases into one platform (80% lower maintenance costs), broke up monoliths, and put CI/CD and monitoring in place that doubled release velocity and cut incident response time by 40%. Has shipped AI/ML to production for 5+ years, from a PyTorch recommendation engine at Emami Frankross and TensorFlow predictive models at Inmar to, most recently, LLM resume parsing and hybrid semantic search for an AI recruitment platform and a multi-agent content pipeline at Magrofy. Deploys on AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions, and works with Claude and Codex as daily coding assistants, holding their output to the same code review and CI checks as any other change.

projects.name: Arccaa Prime - recruitment platform (ATS)
projects.summary: A multi-tenant ATS on Rails 8 and React 19, built from the first commit: jobs, hiring pipelines with a Kanban board, interviews synced to Google and Outlook calendars, a candidate portal, and a public jobs board. Each company’s data is walled off with Postgres row-level security. Resumes come in by upload, bulk upload, or email and are parsed into structured profiles in the background. Recruiter search blends BM25 keyword ranking with pgvector similarity using reciprocal rank fusion, falls back to keywords if the embedding model is down, and supports full Boolean queries. Every candidate gets a match score from weighted skill coverage and semantic similarity, and recruiters see the breakdown and the missing skills. 1,600+ automated tests.

projects.name: ARCCAA AI Engine
projects.summary: Moved the LLM work out of Rails into its own FastAPI service. It parses PDF and Word resumes into structured profiles in a single model call, drafts job descriptions and must-have skills from a title and a few inputs, and writes candidate fit summaries and interview questions from the match data Rails sends. Each task can run on a local Ollama model or any OpenAI-compatible API through config; production uses a hosted model for generation and keeps embeddings on a local 768-dim model so every vector in pgvector stays comparable. Model output is cleaned of code fences, repaired by fallback parsers when the JSON is broken, and if that still fails a rule-based parser returns a usable result instead of an error.

projects.name: AAITS website & CMS
projects.summary: Replaced the company’s WordPress site with Next.js 16 and Payload CMS 3 on Postgres, self-hosted with Docker and Caddy. Wrote a re-runnable import that brought it all into Payload with categories, navigation, SEO fields, and a redirect for every old URL, so no existing link broke. Editors build pages from reusable blocks with drafts, previews, forms, and search; admins sign in with 2FA.

experience.summary: Independent, part-time engagement. Two products built end to end, schema through UI.

projects.name: AronFX VFX Tracker
projects.summary: Built from scratch - an operations and billing platform for VFX production spanning clients, projects, bids, shots, work tracking, vendors, invoices, payments, and multi-currency project metrics, modelled around real VFX work such as roto, paint, camera and object tracking, and compositing. Designed a permission-key authorization model enforced in the backend and mirrored in the UI to drive page, column, and field visibility, alongside JWT refresh tokens, RBAC, TOTP, login-activity tracking, rate limiting, encryption, and audit logging; added invoice PDF generation and Excel import for legacy workbooks.

projects.name: Magrofy Social Engine
projects.summary: SiteCast is a multi-brand agentic content platform for the Magrofy website network. A run moves through Scout, Strategist, Writer, Illustrator, Guardian, Repurposer and Publisher stages with structured JSON outputs, risk tiering, and human approval gates at every exit — an operator picks a site, the model drafts the article and a hero image, a person approves it, and SiteCast publishes to that site's own API and promotes it from that site's own X account. Every website is a Publishing Channel — endpoint, auth type, encrypted credential and a JSON payload template — so adding a site is configuration, not code. Seven are wired up today. Nothing ships unattended: credentials are verified before every publish, scheduled runs are idempotent, and a global kill switch blocks all publishing.

sideProjects.name: AI résumé assistant (sujitpranavreddy.dev)
sideProjects.summary: A chat assistant on my portfolio that answers recruiters' questions using RAG: the résumé and blog posts are chunked by role, project, and skill, embedded into pgvector, and the five closest chunks ground Claude's answer. Career-order questions also get the full timeline, and if retrieval fails it falls back to the whole résumé.
